prompts.background: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a seamless-feeling horizontal 3:1 long panorama background for a gentle interactive toddler camping world. Create ONE very wide 3:1 composition, eye-level view of an unoccupied quiet mountain campsite in late afternoon / early dusk. Soft storybook illustration with rich three-dimensional volume and subtle faceted low-poly surfaces, warm natural colors, detailed clean sharp rendering, similar to a lovely animated-film landscape, not photorealistic. Across the whole foreground is a spacious open mossy grass clearing with occasional tiny wildflowers, pebbles and a few smooth boulders. A crystal-clear shallow mountain stream winds from the distant center-right down to the right foreground, with natural banks, rocks, ripples. Layered pine forest at the sides and middle distance, forested mountains in the far distance. Broad soft blue sky occupies the upper third, a few wispy warm clouds, clean enough for a runtime night-sky dimming effect and stars. Warm early-evening light, cool blue distances, peaceful bedtime-exploration atmosphere. The ground is continuous and stretches a long way horizontally; avoid three separate panels, avoid borders or vignettes. Keep the central and left foreground open enough to place an interactive tent and backpack as separate game sprites later. No people, no human figures, no tent, no backpack, no animals, no stars drawn onto the sky, no buildings, no campfire, no text, no signs, no logos. High clarity in ground plants and stream stones, no artificial blur.
prompts.tent: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: two-pose complete sprite sheet for a toddler mountain camping game. Create a wide 2:1 image with genuine transparent alpha background, precisely TWO equal square cells side by side; the two complete tents must each fit inside their own cell with generous empty padding, no overlap and no cell border. Same ONE identical small cheerful orange dome camping tent in both cells, forest-green bottom trim, dark charcoal thin structural poles, warm cream inner fabric, subtle faceted three-dimensional storybook 3D illustration. Camera is a calm eye-level three-quarter front view looking at the broad entrance; door faces slightly left, structure recedes to the right. The left cell shows the front zip door CLOSED. The right cell shows exactly the same tent with ONLY the two door fabric panels rolled and tied neatly at the sides, revealing a cozy warm cream interior and a simple sleeping mat. Crucially the roof silhouette, outer footprint, pole locations, tent base, camera angle, camera distance, illumination, visual scale, and anchor/ground-line position must match perfectly between the two cells. Do not resize or redraw the entire tent as a different tent for the opened state. Both are complete original drawings; no separate fabric components. Soft natural late-afternoon directional lighting, warm storybook animated-film aesthetic, clean clear volume, not photo realism and not flat cartoon. All stakes and ropes stay inside each cell, minimal loose ropes. No ground patch, no scenery, no labels, no people, no faces, no symbols, no text, no outlines, no colored guide lines, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no opaque white background. The entire surroundings must be truly transparent.
prompts.backpack: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a complete transparent sprite for a toddler camping game. A small sturdy forest-green hiking backpack with tan straps, rounded pockets, one rolled soft cream camping blanket securely fastened on top. Calm eye-level three-quarter view, base flat, all straps attached correctly, complete object with generous empty padding. Soft highly readable three-dimensional storybook illustration, warm late-afternoon light, subtle low-poly faceted volume, playful but no face, no photo-real texture. The surrounding background is genuinely transparent alpha. No ground patch, scenery, people, text, logo, face, border, graphic outline or checkerboard.
prompts.tree: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: complete transparent pine-tree sprite for an interactive mountain camping panorama. ONE attractive living pine tree, full tree from pointed crown down to small exposed lower warm brown trunk, dark and fresh green tiers of pine needles, slightly irregular natural silhouette, credible branching, soft faceted three-dimensional storybook animated-film landscape style, clean details with gentle evening sun highlights. Eye-level view. Generous empty transparent padding around every branch and tree base. No isolated flat sticker outline, no face, no text, no scenery, no grassy ground patch, no shadow blob, no extra tree. Truly transparent alpha background.
prompts.fireflies: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one transparent insect sprite for a gentle toddler evening camping game. ONE small recognizable natural firefly, complete whole insect in three-quarter side view, slightly angled upwards as though floating, tiny dark brown beetle head and thorax, soft warm brown wing covers slightly lifted for flight, two light translucent wings, six fine attached legs, two short antennae, a small golden-yellow glowing light at the tip of the abdomen. Friendly soft three-dimensional storybook illustrative style, natural proportions of a firefly not a cartoon bee, no face or big eyes. Warm gentle glow, not neon, not lens flare. Plenty of empty transparent padding; actual transparent alpha background including around the light glow. No scenery, no text, no stars, no symbols, no white rectangular background, no checkerboard pixels.
prompts.stars: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: tiny transparent star cluster to overlay an evening sky in a toddler camping game. Seven distant stars, spaced organically in a gentle loose cluster, varying tiny sizes, appearing as soft pale-cream pinpoints with small natural subtle four-point sparkle on just two brighter ones. Warm soft understated glow with real transparent alpha surrounding each star. No literal large yellow five-point cartoon icons, no faces, no eyes, no smile, no crescent moon, no planets, no solid background or gradient sky, no text, no graphic border, no checkerboard. This should look like distant points of starlight in a storybook sky, clean and delicate, all points separate and readable.
prompts.stream: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent complete natural stream interaction sprite for a toddler mountain camping panorama. A very small low oblique eye-level section of clear shallow mountain stream bubbling smoothly over three mossy grey rounded pebbles, soft tiny white water ripples and turquoise transparent shallows. The scene fragment is an elongated gently irregular shape, feathered natural transparent water at the edges so it sits over a painted mountain stream and matches the background. Soft painterly three-dimensional volume, subtle faceted stones and evening light, detailed readable storybook landscape, no photorealism. No sticker outline, no fake hard cutout perimeter, no bowl, no waterfall, no large island or full landscape, no surrounding grassy ground patch, no text, people, animals, face, logo or checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha background with generous transparent padding.
